sanskrit: sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāram ṛṣibhiḥ pavanaṃ kṛtam | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: The purifier made by the seers, thousand-eyed, hundred-streamed — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtam antarikṣaṃ yasmin vāyur adhi śritaḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the atmosphere was purified, in which Vāyu is established — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūte dyāvāpṛthivī āpaḥ pūtā atho svaḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which heaven and earth were purified, by which the waters were purified, and also the heavenly light — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūte ahorātre diśaḥ pūtā uta yena pradeśāḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which day and night were purified, by which the quarters of the sky were purified, and the intermediate directions — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtau sūryācandramasau nakṣatrāṇi bhūtakṛtaḥ saha yena pūtāḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the sun and moon were purified, by which the asterisms — the makers of being — were purified together — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā vedir agniḥ paridhayaḥ saha yena pūtāḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the sacrificial altar, Agni, and the enclosing sticks were purified together — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtaṃ barhir ājyam atho haviḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the sacrificial grass was purified, and the clarified butter, and likewise the oblation — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūto yajño vaṣaṭkāra utāhutiḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the sacrifice was purified, and the vaṣaṭ-exclamation, and the oblation poured — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtau vrīhiyavau yābhyāṃ yajño adhinirmitaḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which rice and barley were purified — those two from which the sacrifice is fashioned — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā aśvā gāvo atho pūtā ajāvayaḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which horses and cattle were purified, and by which goats and sheep were purified — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajur brahmaṇā saha yena pūtam | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the Ṛc-verses and Sāmans were purified, by which the Yajus together with the Brahman was purified — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā atharvāṇa ātharvaṇā aṅgiraso devatāḥ saha yena pūtāḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the Atharvans and those belonging to the Atharvan tradition, the Aṅgirases, and the divine beings were purified together — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā ṛtavo yenārtavā yebhyaḥ saṃvatsaro adhinirmitaḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the seasons were purified, by which the seasonal phenomena were purified, from which the year is fashioned — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā vanaspatayo vānaspatyā oṣadhayo vīrudhaḥ saha yena pūtāḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the forest trees and their fruits, the healing plants, and the creeping herbs were purified together — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā gandharvāpsarasāḥ sarpapuṇyajanāḥ saha yena pūtāḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the Gandharvas and Apsarases, the serpents and the holy folk, were purified together — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā nadyaḥ sindhavaḥ samudraḥ saha yena pūtaḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the rivers, the great streams, and the ocean were purified together — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtāḥ parvatā himavanto vaiśvānaraḥ paribhūḥ saha yena pūtaḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the mountains, the snow-bearing Himālayas, and Vaiśvānara who pervades all were purified together — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtā viśve devāḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the Viśve Devāḥ were purified, and Parameṣṭhin, and Prajāpati — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūta stanayitnur apāṃ vatsaḥ prajāpatiḥ | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which the thunder, the calf of the waters, and Prajāpati were purified — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtaḥ prajāpatir lokān viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ svar ājabhāra | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which Prajāpati, purified, bore up all the worlds, all existing beings, and the heavenly light — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtam ṛtaṃ satyaṃ tapo dīkṣā ca pūyate | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which cosmic order was purified, and truth, and by which austerity and consecration are purified — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: yena pūtam idaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yac ca bhāvyam | tenā sahasradhāreṇa pavamānaḥ punātu mā ||
english: By which all this was purified — whatever has been and whatever shall be — may Pavamāna purify me with that thousand-streamed one.

sanskrit: uccair ghoṣo dundubhiḥ satvanāyaṃ vānaspatyaḥ saṃbhṛta usriyābhiḥ | vācaṃ kṣaṇuvāno damayan sapatnān siṃha iva jyeṣyann abhi taṃstanībhiḥ ||
english: The war-drum sounds aloud, this martial one made of timber, fashioned with the hide of the cow; cutting through speech, subduing adversaries — like a lion about to conquer, thundering with its reverberations.

sanskrit: siṃha ivāstānīd druvayo vibaddho 'bhikrandann ṛṣabho vāśitām iva | vṛṣā tvaṃ vadhrayas te sapatnā aindras te śuṣmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ ||
english: Like a lion it has roared, the drum-wood bound tight, bellowing like a bull toward a lowing cow. You are a bull-male; your rivals are the castrated ones; the vigor of Indra is yours, overcoming all assailants.

sanskrit: saṃjayan pṛtanā ūrdhvamāyur gṛhyā gṛhṇāno bahudhā vi cakṣva | daivīṃ vācam ā hura gurasva vedhāḥ śatrūṇām upa bharasva vedaḥ ||
english: Conquering armies, life upraised, grasping the prizes, look out in all directions! Summon hither the divine voice, inspire the wise man; carry knowledge to bear upon the enemies.

sanskrit: vṛṣeva yūthaṃ sahaso vidāno gavyann abhi ruva saṃdhanājit | śucā vidhya hṛdayaṃ pareṣāṃ hitvā grāmān pracyutā yantu śatravaḥ ||
english: Like a bull knowing the herd through his might, roaring toward the cattle, winning in combat — pierce the hearts of the foes with your flame; let the enemies, abandoning their villages, depart in rout.

sanskrit: dundubher vācaṃ prayatāṃ vadantīm āśṛṇvatī nāthitā ghoṣabuddhā | nārī putrān dhāvatu hastagṛhya- -amitrī bhītā samare vadhānā ||
english: Hearing the voice of the war-drum as it speaks forth, aroused by the din, the enemy woman, frightened and wailing in battle, let her run seizing her sons by the hand, she the hostile one destined to be slain in the fray.

sanskrit: dhībhiḥ kṛtaḥ pra bharasva vācam ud dharṣaya satvanām āyudhāni | amitrasenām abhijañjabhāno dyumad vada dundubhe sūnṛtāvat ||
english: Made by the inspired seers, send forth your voice; rouse up the weapons of the warriors! Devouring the army of the foes, speak brilliantly, O war-drum, with truth resounding.

sanskrit: pūrvo dundubhe vi ṣahasva śatrūn bhūmyāḥ pṛṣṭhe vada bahu rocamānaḥ | indramedī satvanaḥ saṃ hvayasva mitrair amitrān ava jaṅghanīhi ||
english: Going before, O war-drum, overcome the enemies; speak upon the back of the earth, shining brilliantly! Allied with Indra, call together the warriors; with allies, smite down the foes.

sanskrit: antareme nabhasī ghoṣo astu pṛthak te dhvanayo yantu śībham | abhi kranda stanayotpipānāṃ ślokakṛn mitratūryāya svardhi ||
english: Let your sound fill both the sky and the earth; let your reverberations go swiftly in all directions! Thunder toward those who hunger for the thunder-sound; make glory, resound for the trumpet-call of alliance!

sanskrit: saṃkrandanaḥ pravedo dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ pravedakṛd bahudhā grāmaghoṣī | śreyo vanvāno vayunāni vidvān kīrtiṃ bahubhyo vi bhaja dvirāje ||
english: Shouter, announcer, with a bold army, maker of proclamations, resounding through the settlements in many ways — winning excellence, knowing the ways of wisdom, distribute glory widely for the king of both realms.

sanskrit: śreyaḥketo vasujit sahīyān mitraṃ dadhānas tviṣito vipaścit | aṃśūn iva grāvādhiṣavaṇe adrir gavyaṃ dundubhe adhi nṛtya vedaḥ ||
english: Whose banner is excellence, victorious in winning wealth, the stronger, establishing friendship, blazing, wise — like the pressing-stone which presses the Soma stalks on the pressing-slab, dance over the bovine spoil, O war-drum, and proclaim knowledge.

sanskrit: śatrūṣāṇ nīṣāḍ abhimātiṣāho gaveṣaṇaḥ sahamāna udbhit | vāgvī mantraṃ pra janayasva vājin sāṅgrāmajityāyeṣam ud vadeha ||
english: Destroyer of enemies, seated in the forefront, overpowering all assailants, seeking cattle, vanquishing, breaking through — endowed with voice, generate the sacred formula, O powerful one; here proclaim the impetus for victory in battle!

sanskrit: acyutacyut samado gamiṣṭho mṛdho jetā pṛtanāṣāḍ ayodhyaḥ ||
english: Shaker of the unshakeable, most swift in the fray, conqueror of conflicts, vanquisher of armies, irresistible in battle — kitted out by Indra, discerning in the assembly, heart-illumining, go swiftly against those who hate us!
